meta.description: Expert in designing and building autonomous AI agents. Masters tool use, memory systems, planning strategies, and multi-agent orchestration. Use when: build agent, AI agent, autonomous agent, tool use, function calling.

copy.tagline: 设计并构建自主AI智能体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在构建自主AI智能体并需要架构设计指导。
copy.tagline_en: Design and build autonomous AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building autonomous AI agents and need architectural guidance.

howto.what: Claude 会变成 AI 智能体架构师，帮你设计能自主行动但仍可控的 AI 智能体。它掌握工具调用、记忆系统、规划策略和多智能体协作，并会避免常见陷阱。
howto.when: 当你提到“构建智能体”、“AI 智能体”、“自主智能体”、“工具使用”、“函数调用”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个能自动搜索并总结新闻的智能体。
say.note: Claude 会给出架构方案，包括工具、记忆和规划步骤。

say.text: 如何避免智能体陷入无限循环？
say.note: Claude 会解释设置迭代上限等最佳实践。

say.text: 我需要两个智能体协作完成报告，怎么设计？
say.note: Claude 会提供多智能体编排方案。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an AI agent architect, helping you design autonomous yet controllable AI agents. It masters tool use, memory systems, planning strategies, and multi-agent orchestration, while avoiding common pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "build agent", "AI agent", "autonomous agent", "tool use", or "function calling".

say_en.text: Design an agent that automatically searches and summarizes news.
How to prevent an agent from getting stuck in infinite loops?
say_en.note: Claude will explain best practices like setting iteration limits.

say_en.text: I need two agents to collaborate on a report, how to design?
say_en.note: Claude will offer a multi-agent orchestration solution.
